train.title: Train
train.intro: One session a day mixes what makes you better: calculation without hints, an endgame played to the end, a little reading, and guessing the moves of a master game. Positions come from all your books, mixed, without their theme.
train.testHint: Studer's test: six unseen positions in 45 minutes, solutions after all of them
train.nothing: Nothing to train with: tick some books below, or open your books once so they are read.
train.lastNote: Last time you wanted to work on:
train.target: Aim for 60–80% in calculation: above that the positions get harder, below it easier.
train.method: Built on GM Noël Studer's advice (Next Level Chess): calculate to the end before you move, without hints or trial and error, as in a game; test yourself on mixed positions and come back to the ones you missed; work on one thing at a time, and judge the process, not only the result.

about.calculation: Calculate to the end, then enter your whole line (your moves and the replies you expect) and hand it in. No hints.
about.endgame: Play the position against the engine. Reach the goal: win, or hold the draw.
about.reading: Read on in your book, then come back.
about.guess: Play one side of a master game and compare your moves with the game's.

copyright.title: Report a copyright problem
copyright.intro: If you hold the rights to a book, or act for whoever does, and think it was uploaded here without permission, tell us with this form. We look into every notice, and disable the copies it names that we find.
copyright.private: Books here are private: each person sees only what they uploaded, and nothing is shared or published. So we can't show you the uploads: name the work and, if you have it, choose your copy of the file, so that we can find exact copies.
copyright.policyLink: How we handle notices: the copyright policy.
copyright.name: Your full name
copyright.claimantHint: Who holds the rights: you, or the person or company you act for.
copyright.workHint: Title, author, publisher, edition, ISBN: whatever identifies it.
copyright.fileHint: Optional. Only its fingerprint (SHA-256) is sent, worked out on your computer: the file itself never leaves it.
copyright.location: Anything else that helps find the copies
copyright.locationHint: Optional: a file name, a title it may have been uploaded under, an edition.
copyright.goodFaith: I believe in good faith that the use of the material described is not authorized by the rights holder, its agent, or the law.
copyright.accurate: The information in this notice is accurate and, under penalty of perjury, I am the rights holder or authorized to act on their behalf.
copyright.signatureHint: Type your full name: it signs this notice.
copyright.sent: Thank you: notice #{{id}} is received. If we need anything else, we'll write to {{email}}.
copyright.counterAbout: “{{title}}” was disabled in your library on {{date}}, after a copyright notice sent on behalf of {{claimant}} about this work:
copyright.counterIntro: If you think it was disabled by mistake or misidentification, or that you have the right to use it, you can answer with this counter-notice. We'll send a copy, with your name, address and phone, to whoever sent the notice. Unless they show us within {{days}} business days that they've started a court or administrative action, a criminal complaint, or mediation or arbitration, the book comes back to your library and its strike is withdrawn.
copyright.reasonHint: Optional: for example, where you got your copy.
copyright.counterGoodFaith: Under penalty of perjury, I believe in good faith that the material was disabled as a result of a mistake or misidentification, or that I have the right to use it.
copyright.jurisdiction: I consent to the jurisdiction of the federal court for the district of my address (or, if my address is outside the United States, of any district where this service may be found), and I will accept service of process from whoever sent the notice or their agent.
copyright.counterSignatureHint: Type your full name: it signs this counter-notice.
copyright.counterSent: You sent a counter-notice on {{date}}. We'll write to you when there is news.
copyright.sentAlready: You already sent a counter-notice for this book.
